description.value:
Over a long rest, with tinker's implements in hand, you rebuild them into a wearable harness mounting a cannon. Whenever you cast a tech power of 1st level or higher while wielding it, your GM may roll a d20 behind the scenes; on a 1, you roll percentile dice on the Unstable Engineering Surge table for a random effect.

The tinkercannon also comes with four overrides, gaining more at higher levels per the engineer table's Modification Slots column. Each time a surge triggers, you may spend an override to reroll the percentile dice — you must keep the new result, and only one reroll is allowed per surge. Each override you spend beyond your proficiency bonus (the count resets on a long rest) lowers your maximum tech points by 1 until your next long rest. All spent overrides return after a long rest.
